method.order: AB, BA, AB, BA, AB, BA per runtime; case order alternates by pair
method.timed: Compile one predicate and scan every index per repetition; accumulate and check index-weighted checksums after timing
method.excluded: Data generation, collection construction, and full per-row correctness checks precede warmup
method.estimate: Per-process medians, paired after/before ratios, geometric mean; deterministic 10000-resample percentile bootstrap over process pairs
